summary: Iteration 145: tested site-settings tiktok_handle (public GET + admin PUT), 'Seguici' block with large central TikTok button + secondary WhatsApp, dynamic handle from backend, multilingual A5 flyer download (IT/DE/EN + fallback), AdminPanel tiktok handle input with save/persistence, and seasonal chip translation regression. Backend 8/8 pytest passed; all frontend checks passed. tiktok_handle restored to 'mikilab.de' at the end (verified via GET).

issues: ~8 console 401 errors fired on initial load before authentication (pre-existing, cosmetic noise in console)

critical_code_review_comments: Optional: silence/guard the unauthenticated API calls that produce 401s on first paint before login to keep the console clean.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily set tiktok_handle to prova.mikilab / qa.test.handle during tests; restored to mikilab.de (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified details: GET /api/site-settings returns tiktok_handle+whatsapp_number, no _id. PUT /api/admin/site-settings strips '@' and extracts handle from full tiktok.com URL; requires admin (401 anon, 403 non-admin). Frontend: promuovi-follow contains large promuovi-social-tiktok (510x174px, href https://www.tiktok.com/@<handle from API>, text '@mikilab.de' + 'The official MikiLab channel') and small promuovi-social-whatsapp (125x38, wa.me/491601253378); no instagram/facebook/threads/youtube. promuovi-flyer-download href: IT->/locandina-mikilab.png, DE->-de.png, EN & FR->-en.png; all 3 assets HTTP 200. Admin card admin-site-settings has admin-tiktok-handle next to admin-wa-number; save shows toast 'Impostazioni salvate' and persists after reload, home button reflects new handle live. Seasonal chip promuovi-season-natale translates (Natale/Weihnachten/Christmas). NOTE: in pytest, calling login on a shared requests.Session sets the session_token cookie — use a fresh session for negative auth tests.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found. One initial test failure was a test artifact (shared session cookie from admin login) and was fixed in the test file.
